description: Call this first. Returns one topic of Jabbertoon's guide as Markdown (under 20,000 characters): start (what it makes and the order of calls), cartoon (the JSON program: cast, scenes, lines, moves), text (the same cartoon as screenplay text), moves, characters, looks, voices, places, errors, limits. Units everywhere: x and y are shares of the stage (0 to 1, the ground at 0.92), times are seconds. Example: {"topic": "cartoon"}.

topic.description: Leave it out for start, which names the others.

name: get_guide
title: Read Jabbertoon's guide for writing a cartoon
